_comment: Permissions for the Claude Skills Toolkit (github.com/LunarCommand/claude-skills).
Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json. The toolkit installs as one plugin at user scope,
so its permissions belong at the same scope; a per-project copy means re-approving the
same toolkit in every repository. That is safe only because this file covers this
toolkit and nothing else. Without it, every bundled script prompts on each call, which
reads as the skill being broken.
Nothing installs this for you — plugin.json has no permissions field and a plugin
cannot ship a settings layer. Merging by hand is the only route there is.
Scripts are approved by BARE NAME, never by path: bin/ reaches the Bash tool's PATH
through the plugin. A bare name failing with 'command not found' means the plugin is
not loaded, not that the rule is wrong.
The ask list is deliberate, not leftover: the git operations the recommended workflow
confirms first, plus the destructive ones adversarial-review's own instructions forbid.
